The task is to write UI strings for a Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) app interface:
- s1: feedback form submit button (sending content to the team)
- s2: settings page button to write/save changes
- s3: status text after changes are saved

Need to use Taiwan Traditional Chinese terminology:
- 提交 → 送出
- 保存 → 儲存 (but for writing changes, "儲存變更" is common; also 「套用」or 「儲存變更」)

s1: The feedback form's submit button that sends content to the team. Common Taiwan phrasing: 「送出意見」or 「送出」. Since it sends content to the team: 「送出意見」or 「送出回饋」. 反饋→回饋, 提交→送出. So 「送出意見」is good. Maybe 「將意見送出給團隊」too long. Just 「送出意見」.

s2: Settings page button to write changes: 「儲存變更」. Common in Taiwan UI: 「儲存變更」.

s3: Status text after changes have been written: 「變更已儲存」or 「您的變更已儲存」. Common: 「變更已儲存」.

Output only JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3.</think>{"s1": "送出意見", "s2": "儲存變更", "s3": "變更已儲存"}
